require 'sinatra'
require 'async'
require 'async/semaphore'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

# In-memory ledger for a simple payment system
class PaymentLedger
  attr_reader :balances, :pending_withdrawals

  def initialize
    @balances = { 'alice' => 1000.0, 'bob' => 500.0, 'charlie' => 750.0 }
    @pending_withdrawals = {}
    @withdrawal_lock = Async::Semaphore.new(1)
    @audit_log = []
  end

  def log_audit(action, user, amount, context = {})
    @audit_log << { action: action, user: user, amount: amount, ts: Time.now.to_f, **context }
  end

  def balance(user)
    @balances[user] || 0.0
  end

  def credit(user, amount)
    @balances[user] = balance(user) + amount
    log_audit(:credit, user, amount)
  end

  def validate_withdrawal(user, amount)
    return { error: 'invalid amount' } if amount <= 0
    return { error: 'unknown user' } unless @balances.key?(user)
    current = balance(user) - pending_total(user)
    return { error: 'insufficient funds' } if current < amount
    nil
  end

  def pending_total(user)
    (@pending_withdrawals[user] || []).sum { |w| w[:amount] }
  end

  def begin_withdrawal(user, amount)
    withdrawal_id = "wd_#{user}_#{Time.now.to_f}_#{SecureRandom.hex(16)}"
    @pending_withdrawals[user] ||= []
    @pending_withdrawals[user] << { id: withdrawal_id, amount: amount, state: :pending }
    log_audit(:begin_withdrawal, user, amount, id: withdrawal_id)
    withdrawal_id
  end

  def finalize_withdrawal(user, withdrawal_id)
    entries = @pending_withdrawals[user] || []
    entry = entries.find { |w| w[:id] == withdrawal_id && w[:state] == :pending }
    return { error: 'withdrawal not found' } unless entry
    entry[:state] = :finalizing
    @balances[user] -= entry[:amount]
    entry[:state] = :complete
    entries.delete(entry)
    log_audit(:finalize_withdrawal, user, entry[:amount], id: withdrawal_id)
    { success: true, new_balance: @balances[user] }
  end

  def process_withdrawal(user, amount)
    @withdrawal_lock.acquire do
      error = validate_withdrawal(user, amount)
      return error if error
      wid = begin_withdrawal(user, amount)
      wid
    end
  end

  def execute_withdrawal(user, withdrawal_id)
    @withdrawal_lock.acquire do
      finalize_withdrawal(user, withdrawal_id)
    end
  end
end

LEDGER = PaymentLedger.new

# Webhook notification system - simulates calling external service
class WebhookNotifier
  def self.notify_withdrawal(user, amount, withdrawal_id, &callback)
    Async do |task|
      # Simulate network latency to external webhook endpoint
      task.sleep(0.01)
      callback.call(user, withdrawal_id) if callback
    end
  end
end

def parse_json_body(request)
  JSON.parse(request.body.read)
rescue JSON::ParserError
  nil
end

# The withdrawal endpoint with async processing
post '/withdraw' do
  content_type :json
  data = parse_json_body(request)
  halt 400, { error: 'invalid JSON' }.to_json if data.nil?
  user = data['user'].to_s.strip
  amount = data['amount'].to_f

  Async do |task|
    wid = LEDGER.process_withdrawal(user, amount)
    if wid.is_a?(Hash) && wid[:error]
      halt 400, wid.to_json
    end

    # Notify webhook and finalize upon confirmation
    WebhookNotifier.notify_withdrawal(user, amount, wid) do |u, w|
      LEDGER.execute_withdrawal(u, w)
    end

    # Return immediately with pending status
    { status: 'pending', withdrawal_id: wid, amount: amount }.to_json
  end.wait
end

# Batch withdrawal - processes multiple withdrawals sequentially for safety
post '/batch_withdraw' do
  content_type :json
  data = parse_json_body(request)
  halt 400, { error: 'invalid JSON' }.to_json if data.nil?
  withdrawals = data['withdrawals'] || []

  results = Async do |task|
    withdrawals.map do |w|
      user = w['user'].to_s.strip
      amount = w['amount'].to_f
      wid = LEDGER.process_withdrawal(user, amount)
      if wid.is_a?(Hash) && wid[:error]
        { user: user, error: wid[:error] }
      else
        result = LEDGER.execute_withdrawal(user, wid)
        { user: user, withdrawal_id: wid, result: result }
      end
    end
  end.wait

  results.to_json
end

get '/balance/:user' do
  content_type :json
  user = params[:user].to_s.strip
  { user: user, balance: LEDGER.balance(user), pending: LEDGER.pending_total(user) }.to_json
end
